⚡ *3 Celestial Trials*
Three mandatory trials at Mahayana sub-layers 1, 5 and 9. Each harder than the last. Failure costs CB in the current realm (never items or progress). 12h cooldown on failure.

announce_heart_demon_tutorial:
👁️ *Tutorial: Heart Demon Tribulation*

Many of you are getting stuck on the 2nd phase of tribulation (Realm 6+). Here's the full guide.

📜 *What it is*
After Thunder, you face *3 moral dilemmas*. It's not a test of power — it's a test of *consistency*. The Demon reads your Dao and checks whether your choices match.

🌌 *How to answer*
Each correct answer depends on your *dominant Dao law* — the law where you have the most fragments. Check /dao to see.

  ⚡ *Lightning* → direct action, no hesitation
  🔥 *Fire* → power, ambition, seize what's yours
  🌿 *Wood* → compassion, preserve life
  ☯️ *Chaos* → balance, the middle path
  🪨 *Earth* → patience, purity

No dominant law? Always pick the *balanced* (☯️) option.

🔮 *Perception*
You need `realm × 50` Perception to see all *3 options*. If you only see 2, you may be missing the correct one. Boost Perception with gear and Body Tempering.

📊 *Scoring*
`0/3` always fails · `1/3` 50% · `2/3` 80% · `3/3` guaranteed

⚠️ *Failure* = CB drops to 80% of threshold + 6h cooldown. With 🛡️ *Heavenly Shield Talisman* it falls to just 5% loss.

💡 *Tip:* from now on, the game shows this tutorial *inside* the tribulation before the questions. Read carefully.

_May your will be unbreakable. — Nivrael Staff_

dqst_10_complete: The demonic whispers in the library fade as the forbidden texts turn to ash.
dqst_10_desc: Evil sects left forbidden texts across the Haunted Library. Purge every floor.
dqst_10_intro: Knowledge is power, but demonic texts corrupt the soul. Burn every forbidden scroll in the library.
dqst_11_complete: The dark waters run clear again as the leviathan's carcass sinks to the bottom.
dqst_11_desc: Something lurks in the Dark Waters. Dive to floor 10 and conquer the aquatic beast.
dqst_11_intro: The river runs black with corruption. A leviathan resides deep below. Slay it!
dqst_12_complete: You emerge from the ashes victorious, clutching a scorching Phoenix Feather.
dqst_12_desc: A legendary Phoenix dropped a feather in its nest. Only those who clear it can claim the prize.
dqst_12_intro: I saw it! A genuine Phoenix! The intense heat drove me away. Can you endure the flames and find its feather?
dqst_13_complete: The thick, pulsing dragon blood is secured. Such rich vitality is intoxicating to behold.
dqst_13_desc: Extract the condensed Dragon Blood from the deepest layer of the Dragon's Lair.
dqst_13_intro: The blood of dragons grants boundless vitality. Bring me a pure sample from the inner sanctum.
dqst_14_complete: The grand legacy of the ancient sect has been reclaimed from the rubble.
dqst_14_desc: Reclaim the lost scriptures of an ancient sect from their ruined domain.
dqst_14_intro: My ancestors ruled these lands! Retrieve our sovereign seal from the deepest ruin.
dqst_15_complete: With a powerful pulse of spatial energy, the tear snaps shut, stabilizing the realm.
dqst_15_desc: A tear in the Void Rift threatens to swallow a nearby mortal continent. Seal it.
dqst_15_intro: The spatial tear is expanding! Navigate the chaotic void and mend the gap.
dqst_16_complete: The Demon Sovereign falls! Without his command, the demonic legions scatter in fear.
dqst_16_desc: The Sovereign of the Demon Palace is rallying an army. Assault the palace and assassinate him.
dqst_16_intro: The demonic legions prepare for war. We must sever the head of the snake.
dqst_17_complete: You stand atop the Celestial Tower. The heavens themselves seem to bow to your might.
dqst_17_desc: To ascend the Celestial Tower is to challenge the heavens. Reach the pinnacle.
dqst_17_intro: Few dare to challenge the Tower. Show the heavens your unrivaled Dao.
dqst_18_complete: You have gazed into the abyss, and you did not blink. The primordial secrets are yours.
dqst_18_desc: Dive into the Primordial Abyss and retrieve a fragment of the universe's origin.
dqst_18_intro: The Abyss holds secrets older than time. Beware the ancient guardian.
dqst_19_complete: Your body radiates with tribulation lightning. You have survived the worst the heavens could muster.
dqst_19_desc: Survive 20 waves in the Tribulation Ground to forge your physique.
dqst_19_intro: Lightning, fire, and wind! Endure the Heavenly Tribulations to temper your body.
dqst_1_complete: You recovered the ancient scroll. The disciple is forever indebted to you.
dqst_1_desc: There are rumors of an ancient scroll lost by a careless disciple on the 5th floor. Find it for the sect.
dqst_1_intro: I dropped my master's scroll! Please, brave cultivator, retrieve it before the undead destroy it.
dqst_20_complete: The phantom bows deeply. You have earned the absolute respect of the ancient Venerable.
dqst_20_desc: An old Venerable rests in the Immortal's Tomb. Defeat his phantom to gain his approval.
dqst_20_intro: I have waited millennia for a worthy successor. Prove your strength against my martial phantom.
dqst_21_complete: The Behemoth dissolves into pure energy. Order slowly returns to the Chaos Realm.
dqst_21_desc: The Chaos Realm is destabilizing. Vanquish the Chaos Behemoth to restore balance.
dqst_21_intro: Absolute chaos reigns! Everything is twisting. Slay the Behemoth before it consumes reality.
dqst_22_complete: The Asura Commander falls, and a collective sigh of relief echoes across the empty battlefield.
dqst_22_desc: End the perpetual suffering in the Ancient Battlefield by vanquishing the Asura Commander.
dqst_22_intro: The souls here have fought for ten thousand years. Slay the Commander so we may finally rest.
dqst_23_complete: You touch the Dao Origin. Boundless enlightenment surges through your meridians. You are unrivaled.
dqst_23_desc: Reach the origin of all Daos across the 50 floors of the Dao Origin to claim supreme enlightenment.
dqst_23_intro: All paths lead to the origin. Only the apex cultivator can touch the heart of the Dao.
dqst_2_complete: The spirits have dissipated. You can hear the rhythmic striking of picks starting anew.
dqst_2_desc: The Haunted Mines are overflowing with vengeful spirits. Purge the entire dungeon to lay them to rest.
dqst_2_intro: We cannot mine here anymore. The spirits are too aggressive! Clear the mine for us.
dqst_3_complete: The void stabilizes around you. The realms are safe for another eon.
dqst_3_desc: A strange void anomaly has appeared in the Nascent Void. Defeat its core to stabilize the region.
dqst_3_intro: The space in the Nascent Void is collapsing. If you do not conquer the anomaly, it might swallow the outer realms!
dqst_4_complete: You defeated the source of the whispers. A chilling silence replaces the maddening noise.
dqst_4_desc: You have been hearing voices whispering from the Abyssal Rift. Investigate the deepest floor.
dqst_4_intro: Do you hear them? The whispers... They call from the deepest abyss. Silence them.
dqst_5_complete: You passed the trial. The ancient entity acknowledges your indomitable will.
dqst_5_desc: The Immortal Trial tests one's patience. Survive all floors to prove your worth.
dqst_5_intro: Time has no meaning here. If you wish to inherit my legacy, endure the trial to the bitter end.
dqst_6_complete: The mist clears, revealing bones of those who lost their way. The path is safe once more.
dqst_6_desc: A strange mist obscures the first few floors of the Misty Cave. Dissipate it by reaching floor 4.
dqst_6_intro: The mist is blinding! I lost my way. Reach the 4th floor and break the formation causing this fog.
dqst_7_complete: The looters have been driven out. The ancestors can finally rest in peace.
dqst_7_desc: Grave robbers have desecrated the tombs up to floor 8. Stop them and secure the artifacts.
dqst_7_intro: Those scoundrels are looting the ancestors! Cleanse the tomb up to the 8th chamber!
dqst_8_complete: The demonic stalks have been reduced to splinters. The forest air feels refreshing again.
dqst_8_desc: The Bamboo Forest has overgrown dangerously with spiritual demonic bamboo. Clear the grove.
dqst_8_intro: The bamboo has gained sentience and is attacking travelers! Cut them down!
dqst_9_complete: The corrupted vein shatters. The remaining crystals lose their sinister glow.
dqst_9_desc: A corrupted spirit vein is spawning crystal beasts. Eliminate the core to stop the mutation.
dqst_9_intro: The crystals are alive! They are devouring the miners. Crush the central vein!

⚠️ *Your Foundation Quality determines your future!*

🔑 How it works:
• Your stats (Soul, Perception, Luck) determine Foundation Quality
• Foundation Quality limits your maximum Golden Core tier:
  - 🟫 Low → Max Core: Normal
  - 🥈 Medium → Max Core: Superior
  - 🥇 High → Max Core: Perfect
  - 💎 Perfect → Max Core: Perfect

📊 Core Essence limits by Foundation:
  - Low: max 100 essence
  - Medium: max 200 essence
  - High/Perfect: max 300 essence

💊 *Tip: Use pills BEFORE attempting the trial!*
  - Soul Condensation Pill: +5 Soul
  - Mind Clarity Pill: +5 Perception
  - Fortune Pill: +3 Luck

q_610_desc: The village of White Pine lives beneath Azure Cloud's veil of mist, and famine has come with the drought of Linghe's celestial rivers. Sit in meditation for thirty minutes and let your qi rise as an offering to the heavens, so the mercy of the clouds may once more rain upon the people who trusted in our protection.
q_610_name: The Vow of the Wandering Cloud
q_611_desc: The same sacred mist that shields White Pine has become a hiding place: fallen cultivators use our cloud-veil to ambush pilgrims on the trails of Linghe. Azure Cloud's freedom was never a license to plunder — defeat two of these wandering bandits and return the paths to those who travel beneath the open sky.
q_612_desc: A sect-brother twisted the vow of the cloud: he took the freedom we swore to protect and turned it into tyranny over those we should shelter. The Elder withdraws into the silence of the heights and leaves the verdict in your hands, once you face him in a duel before the sect.
q_612_name: The Cloud That Turned to Storm
q_613_desc: The mother-flame of the Pavilion, lit since its founding in Linghe, has guttered down to a single ember, and no furnace in the hall can rekindle it. The Elder commands you to feed the inner fire by meditating twenty-five minutes, letting your own qi burn as fuel so the Eternal Flame never dies. If the flame dies we kindle another, yet this one must not die through your neglect.
q_614_desc: Disciples of the rival Thousand Bloom spread the word through every hall of Linghe that the Eternal Flame is nothing but cold ash now, toothless and burnt out, a House the Dao itself has abandoned. The Elder orders you to silence the scorn where it stings most by winning three duels in the arena, each victory rekindling the House's name before every cultivator.
q_615_desc: At last you cross blades with the Thousand Bloom prodigy who mocked the House, and in a single duel you corner him with no way out, his qi flickering like a candle in the wind. Glory blows hot in your ear, yet the Elder whispers that true fire knows when to blaze and when to hold; at the end of the bout, the choice is yours.
q_616_desc: A shudder of imbalance rises from the Abyssal Depths and makes the qi ley-lines of Linghe ripple like fouled water; you feel the discord even in your own breath. Sit in harmony-meditation for 30 minutes to resettle your core and return balance to the earth's veins.
q_617_desc: Two Abyssal cultists have crept upward to defile an ancient jade shrine with corrupted qi. Drive off the two wandering cultivators without letting hatred into your heart, for the clean strike is born of calm, not of wrath.
q_618_desc: A sect-brother, seduced by abyssal power, broke the harmony and harmed an innocent; the Elders hand him to you for judgment. Cross blades with him in a single sparring trial and then, with your core still serene, pronounce the House's verdict.
q_619_desc: Before the first ray of dawn touches the Mountain Gate, the Elder bids you sit unmoving upon the cold stone and temper flesh and will through stillness. Meditate for thirty minutes, yielding neither to the trembling nor the cold, for in Iron Mountain the body is the strongest sword, and the body that does not move through one night will never break across a century.
q_620_desc: The mountain's roots groan: the ancient passage threading the heart of Qianhe threatens to collapse upon the brothers who guard it. The Elder does not send the swift to flee, but the steadfast to descend. Hold each level on your own shoulders and your own tempered flesh, clearing eight floors until the stone ceases its weeping.
q_621_desc: A sworn brother fled his post, seized by fear, and because of it others were nearly buried alive beneath the stone. The Elder lowers the granite hammer before you and falls silent: the Mountain's verdict shall be yours. Measure the man in a single sparring bout, see with your own eyes whether any steel remains in him, then pronounce his fate.
q_622_desc: The Elders of Frozen Peak summon you to the deepest meditation hall, where breath itself crystallizes in the air. Sit within the stillness of ice and cultivate for 35 minutes unbroken, until the cold silences your mind and the Dao whispers in the motionlessness.
q_623_desc: The spring thaw has opened paths through the ice, and wandering cultivators climb the peak to loot the shrines of the frost arts. Serenity is not weakness: defeat 2 of these intruders and send them back to the frozen valley from which they came.
q_624_desc: A disciple shattered the sacred silence and leaked the House's frost arts to outsiders, endangering all of Frozen Peak. The Elders name you judge: face the transgressor in a single trial-spar, and then pronounce the verdict the ice demands.
q_625_desc: The Sacred Garden of Ten Thousand Herbs sickens, and every Dao-flower bows its corolla as if weeping. The Elder asks you to kneel among the beds and meditate for 30 minutes, letting your qi sink to the roots like a gentle rain. Here in Yanshan, every breath you refine nourishes the life the Thousand Bloom swore to protect.
q_626_desc: Two wandering cultivators raid the beds to tear out the rare spirit-herbs and bleed them into the shadow markets, trampling centuries of the Thousand Bloom's cultivation. Each root they defile bears a living Dao. Find and defeat the 2 marauders, driving them off before the sacred harvest becomes coin in greedy hands.
q_627_desc: The truth reeks worse than the rot: a disciple of the Thousand Bloom secretly refined the garden's healing herbs into poison and sold it to outsiders, betraying the Sect's oath to life. Confront him in a single sparring trial; once he yields, the Elder lays the verdict in your hands.
q_628_desc: The Palace Elder points to the mat and says nothing more: meditate on the breath for 25 minutes, until your qi runs soundless and your presence dissolves like wind among the leaves. The first lesson of the House is not to strike, but to vanish. Still the breath and sharpen the wind before the Master calls.
q_629_desc: Time is short: win 3 arena duels by striking first, while the lumbering Iron Mountain still raises its guard. Prove to the Master that the wind cuts before the foe ever feels the cold at his throat, for the rival House already moves its pieces across Yanshan.
q_630_desc: Now: you catch a lone Iron Mountain envoy carrying secrets that could humble the rival House. Win the single duel before he reaches the gates, and with the blade already raised, decide in a single breath. Strike for glory, or stay the wind.
q_630_name: The Envoy Alone in the Mist
q_631_desc: At the peak of noon, when no shadow dares to exist, you sit upon the Blazing Sun pyre and meditate for twenty-five minutes, drawing the fire of the star down into your core until every weakness burns and crumbles to ash. The Elder watches in silence: only a qi that has endured the noonday fire deserves to carry this Sect's name across Fenghuo.
q_632_desc: The Azure Cloud Sect hides its cowardice behind its eternal mist, refusing to face the Sun head-on. The Elder commands: go to the arena and win three duels, tearing those cultivators out of their fog and exposing them under the light where no shadow can lie.
q_632_name: Drag the Mist Into the Light
q_633_desc: You have cornered the Azure Cloud disciple who spat upon the name of the Blazing Sun, and now he trembles with no mist left to hide in. Win this single duel and, with your blade at his throat, judge his fate beneath the all-seeing star.
q_633_name: The Cornered Shadow Beneath the Sun
q_634_desc: A whisper of buried treasure rises from the depths of Moyu, sweet as cracked bone. What Heaven rejects, the Abyss keeps. Sink into meditation for 25 minutes and let the Abyss steer your divine sense toward the echo of forgotten gold.
q_635_desc: The echo ends at a vault driven shut by an ancestral seal, hungry for any hand that dares. Heaven gives a demon nothing freely: break through ten dungeon floors and tear away the seal's wards, floor by floor, until the forbidden qi within recognizes its master.
q_636_desc: The vault yawns open and the forbidden treasure pulses, but it demands a price paid in soul, and a disciple of Jade Harmony, your eternal rival, reaches for the same prize. Best them in a single confrontation, then choose: devour it all, master the thirst, or share with the House.

q_7_desc: Win an Arena or Sparring combat
q_8_desc: Consume 3 pills to boost your cultivation
q_9_desc: Donate 5000 Spirit Stones to your sect's vault
qc_12_endure_alone_result: You face the tribulation with neither help nor distraction. To survive is victory enough.
qc_12_shield_others: 🛡️ Take the lightning for a peer
qc_12_shield_others_result: You step in and take the bolt meant for another cultivator. New scars, a cleaner soul.
qc_16_escort_weak_result: You carry a weaker disciple through the dangerous floors. Slower, but no one is left behind.
qc_16_loot_first: 💰 Grab the loot, leave allies behind
qc_16_loot_first_result: You snatch the treasures and leave allies in the dark. The loot is rich — their silence, heavy.
qc_16_speedrun_result: You blaze through the floors at your own pace, no dead weight. Efficient and direct.
qc_1_forbidden_absorb: 🩸 Siphon the ambient Qi others rely on
qc_1_forbidden_absorb_result: You devour the Qi others breathe. Your foundation swells — but something cold settles in your heart.
qc_1_hoard_result: You seal every thread of Qi within yourself. Progress is progress — none may fault you for it.
qc_1_share_qi_result: You channel your surplus Qi to a struggling disciple. He bows in gratitude — and the Heavens note your kindness.
qc_2_counterfeit: 🃏 Pass off flawed pills as perfect
qc_2_counterfeit_result: You sell refuse as masterwork. Gold flows easily — and your word rots a little.
qc_2_gift_pills: 🎁 Donate the pills to the infirmary
qc_2_gift_pills_result: You hand the pills to the sect's wounded. Fewer stones, but the elders' respect is worth more.
qc_2_sell_fair_result: You sell the pills honestly at market. Fair name, fair coin, and herbs in change.
qc_3_cripple_result: You crush your foe's meridians far past need. He will never forget — nor will the Heavens.
qc_3_honor_result: You fight with skill and honor. No tricks, no cruelty — only the art.
qc_3_mercy_result: You lower your blade and salute your foe. Mercy is the mark of true masters.
qc_5_capture_result: You bind the beast firmly but with care. An honest hunter's work.
qc_5_harvest_core_result: You slay the beast and tear out its still-warm core. Raw power, bought in blood.
qc_5_release_rare_result: You release the wounded spirit beast. It vanishes into the mist — and something in the world thanks you.
qc_602_cruelty_result: Your punishment echoes down the halls. The House fears you — and your soul cools a little.
qc_602_honor: Apply the Sect's law, without hatred
qc_602_honor_result: Just punishment, measured. The House sees a future Elder in you.
qc_602_mercy: Forgive the disciple and teach him
qc_602_mercy_result: You plead for the youth. The Elder nods, slowly. Mercy, too, is a Dao.
qc_612_expose: Expose and strip his rank before all
qc_612_expose_result: You tear the cloud emblem from his chest and proclaim his shame before the whole sect, seizing all that he stole. The storm made its example, but something cold settles in your conscience. You lose 20 karma, take 500 spirit-stones from the seized assets and gain 25 sect contribution.
qc_612_justice: Uphold the sect's law, without cruelty
qc_612_justice_result: You speak the law of Azure Cloud with neither anger nor softness, and the brother accepts the sentence as a cloud bends to the wind. The Elder descends from the heights and honors duty fulfilled above all. You gain 0 karma, 350 spirit-stones and 50 sect contribution.
qc_612_mercy: Forgive: compassion is the higher Dao
qc_612_mercy_result: You lower your blade and lift the fallen brother, recalling that the cloud covers the righteous and the wayward alike. The Elder bows his head in silent approval, and the sky feels lighter over Linghe. You gain 20 karma, 250 spirit-stones and 35 sect contribution.
qc_615_glory: Press the advantage and seize glory before all
qc_615_glory_result: You press while the prodigy reels and tear the victory free under the eyes of the whole arena; the name of the Eternal Flame burns again in the mouths that called it ash. The Elder nods, satisfied, and the Thousand Bloom swallow their laughter. The House rises once more, and the spectators fill your hands with spirit-stones for the spectacle.
qc_615_prudence: Hold back and spare the rival, preserve the House and its people
qc_615_prudence_result: You lower your guard and spare the fallen prodigy, recalling that a flame which devours all around it consumes itself first. The Elder closes his eyes with rare pride: no victory honors the House more than the wisdom of knowing when to hold, and it is this wisdom the Eternal Flame prizes above all. The Elders reward your judgment with spirit-stones and write your name high in the sect's records.
qc_615_ruthless: Crush the rival at any cost, no mercy
qc_615_ruthless_result: You burn the prodigy's qi core until his cultivation turns to cold ash, a flame snuffed out that may never light again. The Thousand Bloom fall silent with dread and pour spirit-stones at your feet to soothe your wrath, but something darkens within you, and the Elder turns his face away: there are fires that give light, and fires that leave only ruin behind. The karma of the House now carries the weight of what you did.
qc_618_expose: Expose and strip his rank before all
qc_618_expose_result: You drag him before the whole sect, tear his emblem and seize his assets as a cold example; he leaves broken, and the silence after is chill. The seized assets weigh heavy in your hand, yet a stain settles upon your own conscience as well.
qc_618_justice: Uphold the House law, neither cruel nor soft
qc_618_justice_result: You weigh the offense by the House's serene measure and impose the just penalty, not a grain more nor less. The Elders bow their heads: you served duty above feeling, and Jade Harmony rewards most the guardian who keeps the scales steady.
qc_618_mercy: Forgive: compassion is the higher Dao
qc_618_mercy_result: You lower your blade and extend your hand; he falls to his knees weeping black qi from his eyes, and the harmony slowly takes him back. The House murmurs that mercy too is balance, and your name shines the cleaner for it.
qc_621_expose: Expose and strip rank: let him be an example
qc_621_expose_result: You drag the brother before the whole House, tear off his emblem and seize his assets before the silent disciples, adding five hundred spirit-stones to the Mountain's coffers. Fear teaches quickly and the stone grows harder for it, yet the cold climbing your spine warns that something in your own heart has turned to stone as well, and not all granite returns to flesh.
qc_621_justice: Apply the House law, neither cruel nor soft
qc_621_justice_result: You impose the sentence the Mountain has always imposed: labor in the stone until the debt is paid, not one blow more, not one pardon less. Without wrath and without pity, only duty borne as granite bears its weight. The Elder hands you three hundred and fifty spirit-stones and carves your name into the granite, for the Iron House honors above all the one who serves duty without bending it.
qc_621_mercy: Forgive: even iron bends before it breaks
qc_621_mercy_result: You lift the fallen brother by the wrist and return him to his post, saying a coward who comes back to temper himself is worth more than a corpse that learns nothing. Only true strength can raise the weak rather than crush them. The Elder nods slowly and presses two hundred and fifty spirit-stones into your hand, for the Mountain remembers those who walk the higher Dao of compassion.
qc_624_expose: Publicly shame and strip rank; make an example
qc_624_expose_result: You drag the disciple before the whole House, strip his rank, and seize his assets under the cold gaze of the Elders. The example freezes the heart of all who watch, and the seized goods yield 500 spirit stones and 25 sect contribution; but cruelty stains your conscience, and your karma falls by 20.
qc_624_justice: Uphold the House's law evenly, without cruelty
qc_624_justice_result: You pronounce the sentence as ice pronounces winter: firm, without wrath, without excess mercy. Duty done without deviation is Frozen Peak's purest cultivation, and the Elders honor you with 350 spirit stones and 50 sect contribution; your karma remains untouched.
qc_624_mercy: Spare the transgressor; compassion is a higher Dao
qc_624_mercy_result: You lower your blade and offer the repentant disciple the chance to purge his fault in frozen meditation. The Peak learns that even ice yields rather than shatter; the Elders reward you with 250 spirit stones and 35 sect contribution, and your karma rises by 20.
qc_627_expose: Expose and strip his rank before all
qc_627_expose_result: You drag him to the courtyard and reveal his crime before the whole Sect, stripping his rank and seizing all the poison earned. The disciples fall into a frozen silence; you made the traitor an example, but something cold settles in your chest and stains your own conscience (karma -20, 500 spirit-stones in seized assets, +25 sect contribution).
qc_627_justice: Uphold the House's law in fair measure
qc_627_justice_result: You pronounce the sentence with neither cruelty nor softness, expelling him from the Sect as the Thousand Bloom code demands. The Elder nods gravely: no petal weighs more than another on the scale, and the House honors above all those who keep their duty (karma 0, 350 spirit-stones, +50 sect contribution).
qc_627_mercy: Spare him; mercy is the higher Dao
qc_627_mercy_result: You raise the bowed disciple and bind him to penitent meditation, for a broken root may yet bloom. The Elder smiles with damp eyes: the Thousand Bloom see in you the heart that cultivates life even in one who has failed (karma +20, 250 spirit-stones, +35 sect contribution).
qc_630_glory: Press the advantage and claim the glory
qc_630_glory_result: You tear the secrets free and vanish into the mist before the alarm, spilling no more blood than the duel demanded. The name of Silent Wind races through the sects of Yanshan and Iron Mountain wakes the poorer. The House grants you 450 spirit-stones and raises your contribution by 40, with neither stain nor virtue: only the renown of the one who strikes first.
qc_630_prudence: Stay the blade and preserve the House
qc_630_prudence_result: You lower the blade and let the envoy go, choosing the House and its people over a reckless win, for a wind that shows itself too soon loses a thousand mountains for one hill, and a corpse in the mist would only bring war to the gates. The Elders smile at wisdom few disciples ever cultivate. The House grants you 250 spirit-stones, raises your contribution by 50, and your karma rises by 15.
qc_630_ruthless: Win at any cost and crush the rival
qc_630_ruthless_result: You cross the line the Elders never speak aloud and silence the envoy for good, carrying secret and blood in the same mist. Iron Mountain will bleed for years, but something cold now sleeps in your chest, and the wind you are has grown a shade darker. The House grants you 550 spirit-stones and raises your contribution by only 25, while your karma plunges by 20.
qc_633_glory: Press the advantage and claim the glory
qc_633_glory_result: You surge forward without hesitation and tear victory free in full light; Azure Cloud gathers its own in silence as your name blazes on the lips of the Sect. The Elder nods: the Sun did not retreat, and neither did you. You receive four hundred and fifty spirit stones and your name rises forty points in the Sect's records.
qc_633_prudence: Stay your hand and spare the House its excess
qc_633_prudence_result: You lower your blade and leave the rival alive, for a reckless victory would cost the Blazing Sun more than the humiliation of Azure Cloud is worth. The Elder smiles with rare respect: true fire warms the House before it burns the enemy. Your karma rises fifteen, you receive two hundred and fifty spirit stones and fifty contribution points, for above all else the Sect prizes wisdom.
qc_633_ruthless: Crush the rival at any cost
qc_633_ruthless_result: You cross the line no judge of the Sun should ever cross and burn the rival down until nothing remains but cold ash and a warning. The victory is total, yet the star lends this light no warmth; it only consumes. Your karma falls twenty, you receive five hundred and fifty spirit stones and twenty-five contribution points, bought at a price your shadow will carry.
qc_636_restraint: Master the thirst and seal the treasure
qc_636_restraint_result: You shut the vault before it can devour you from within, a rare wisdom in a demon. Little gold reaches the House, yet the Elder lifts an eyebrow and carves your name deep: a devourer who knows when NOT to devour is worth more to the Depths than a thousand hungry mouths. Your standing before the House rises greatly.
qc_636_seize: Devour it all, damn the Heavens
qc_636_seize_result: You wrench the forbidden treasure for yourself and drink its price to the last drop; the gold pours into your spatial ring, but something within you darkens and goes cold. The Abyss smiles: it always knew you were its own, and Heaven merely turns its face away.
qc_636_share: Split the spoils with the House
qc_636_share_result: You split the spoils with the House and leave the Jade Harmony disciple to swallow their own rage empty-handed. Cold pragmatism, with no nobility in it: the Depths thrive when their devourers feed together, and your loyalty is carved in gold and in debt.
qc_6_glory_result: You pour all your power into the kill. The glory is yours, and yours alone.
qc_6_protect_result: You draw the colossus's fury away from the innocent. They live — and your name spreads through the villages.
qc_7_claim_spoils_result: You collect what you won by right. Clean victory, fair reward.
qc_7_humiliate_result: You grind the loser's honor before the crowd. They laugh with you — and fear you.
qc_7_spare_result: You offer a hand to your fallen rival. A foe spared may become an ally.

📜 Saint speaking — small fixes + the road ahead

I saw your feedback in the chat and want to bring you up to speed.

🔧 Small bugs fixed today
• Locked T1 recipes — 4 Tier 1 pills (Cleansing, Qi Amass, Iron Skin, Lucky Star) stayed forever as '??? — Recipe not discovered' because drops only roll T2 and up. All 10 T1 recipes now auto-unlock when you open /alchemy. Existing players receive them retroactively next time they enter the menu.

• Mini-app: artifact stats now reflect actual grade (G4 vs G6 differ).
• Reflection Chamber (endgame Apex) gets a button inside /celestial and clearer flavor text.

🌌 About the 3000 Dao Laws pace
. commented that progress feels stuck. It is *intentional* — it is paced for 2-3 months minimum, which gives me time to build the next layers and keeps the path long. Your perception has a cap in this realm. When the world breaks the limit (next realm at the Imperial Launch), the world's Qi rises and discovery rate amortizes.

Pills that help *now*:
• 👁️ Soul Clarity Pill — temporary perception boost.
• 🌪️ Qi Vortex Pill (T3) and Heavenly Spring (T4) — more Qi regen = more Dao meditation ticks.
• ☯️ Pills with Dao-fragment-chance effect — direct multiplier.

🗺️ Next steps for the game
• Sprint v14.4 (next): full Foundation system — /restart for newbies, 'Break the Foundation' ritual realm 5+, Eternal Foundation Pill (Heavenly-grade craftable, Sacred Foundation tier).
• Imperial Launch: new realms, races, pet soul-bonds, more Heavenly Daos. Wipe confirmed but with full refund + premium gifts.

_Keep reporting bugs in chat. It is helping. — Saint_

release_v15_2b_intent_tree:
🌳 *Intent System — The Five Paths*

A new layer of your cultivation awakens. Every soul that trains enough develops *Intent* — the mark of will carved into technique.

*The 5 Paths:*
• 🗡️ *Sword* — cutting, precision, the blade's soul
• 👊 *Fist* — raw impact, physical will
• 🛡️ *Body* — endurance, regeneration, fortress
• 🌀 *Dao* — essence, perception, soul
• 🥷 *Killing* — assassination, evasion, the single strike

*How to level up:*
1. *Every use* of a technique in combat grants *+3 XP* in its path. The more you fight with Sword techniques, the higher your Sword Intent climbs.
2. *Winning a duel* grants *+15 XP* bonus on your dominant path (the one you used most).
3. *Losing* still grants *+3 XP* — you're never softlocked.
4. Each rank (0 → 9) adds *permanent passive bonus* to ALL techniques of that path: +2% damage (Sword/Fist/Killing), +1.5% damage reduction (Body), +1.5% armor ignore (Dao), +1% evasion (Killing).

*Counterplay:* Sword > Body > Fist > Sword (classical). Dao > Killing. Killing > Sword/Body. When you attack with advantage, you gain *+5%/rank extra damage* (up to +50%).

*Persistence through Rebirth:* Intent is soul mastery — it does *not* reset on prestige. But your Mortal body limits what you can manifest (effective rank). As you climb realms again, you unlock the original power.

*Where to see it:*
• Open the mini-app → ⚔️ *Combat*
• See your dominant path chip always visible with XP bar
• Tap *The Five Paths* for the full tree (rank, current bonus, next rank, lore)
• Each technique's detail now shows which path it feeds

_"He who follows the Sword cuts the sky itself. Five paths, one cultivator."_
— Sutra of the Five Intentions, Chapter I

sty_enc_fenghuo_tempera_desc: Steel that has not drunk never holds a real blow. The Forge wants proven blades, not new ones.
sty_enc_linghe_escolta_d1: Three caravans set out. Not one arrived whole.
sty_enc_linghe_escolta_d2: This city eats what comes through those gates. Walk with them.
sty_enc_linghe_escolta_desc: Not one caravan arrived whole this week. Wànshì lives on what comes through its gates — and nothing is coming through.
sty_enc_linghe_selos_d1: The magistrate signed the order this morning without looking at anyone.
sty_enc_linghe_selos_d2: Go down, close what you can, and come back to sign under his name.
sty_enc_linghe_selos_desc: The portals around Wànshì have been spitting things out. The magistrate pays whoever goes down and closes what they can.
sty_enc_linghe_vigilia_d1: The nine houses argued all night and agreed on exactly one thing: someone has to sit.
sty_enc_linghe_vigilia_d2: We are not asking for faith. We are asking for hours.
sty_enc_linghe_vigilia_desc: The nine sects demand a shift of meditation at the square's altars. Whoever sits, sits for the whole city.
sty_enc_moyu_ecos_d1: Something down there is using my sister's voice.
sty_enc_moyu_ecos_d2: My sister died twelve years ago. Silence it.
sty_enc_moyu_ecos_desc: Something in the ruins is imitating the voices of living people. The city wants silence.
sty_enc_moyu_ruinas_d1: There are floors under this city that nobody has ever drawn.
sty_enc_moyu_ruinas_d2: Go down. Come back. If you come back, bring something.
sty_enc_moyu_ruinas_desc: There are floors beneath the city that nobody has mapped. Whoever goes down and returns brings back things that should not exist.
sty_enc_moyu_vigilia_d1: Here we meditate with our eyes open. Those who close them do not open them again.
sty_enc_moyu_vigilia_d2: Sit long enough and the thing shows itself.
sty_enc_moyu_vigilia_desc: In Mòyǔ one meditates with open eyes. Sit long enough and whatever whispers eventually shows itself.
sty_enc_qianhe_carga_d1: Half the beasts of burden vanished into last season's ice.
sty_enc_qianhe_carga_d2: Bring them back. Or bring others — the Temple does not count snouts.
sty_enc_qianhe_carga_desc: The Temple bred beasts to haul stone and lost half of them to the ice. Bring them back, or bring others.
sty_enc_qianhe_minerio_d1: The river opened a new vein and the Temple has no arms to spare.
sty_enc_qianhe_minerio_d2: Go down. Come back loaded. Nobody asks how.
sty_enc_qianhe_minerio_desc: The underground rivers opened new veins. The Temple needs hands that go down and come back loaded.
sty_enc_qianhe_provas_d1: The disciples are convinced they already know how to hit.
sty_enc_qianhe_provas_d2: Go down there and unconvince them.
sty_enc_qianhe_provas_desc: The Temple's disciples need someone who hits harder than they do. You will do.
sty_enc_yanshan_colheita_d1: The Ten Thousand opened yesterday and the beasts got there first.
sty_enc_yanshan_colheita_d2: Go fetch what is left before there is nothing left.
sty_enc_yanshan_colheita_desc: The flowers open once a season and the beasts arrive before the harvesters. Go fetch what is left.
sty_enc_yanshan_pilulas_d1: The common cauldron is scraping bottom and fever season has started.
sty_enc_yanshan_pilulas_d2: Fill it. The Garden does not ask where the herb came from.
sty_enc_yanshan_pilulas_desc: The Garden shares what it refines. Fill the common cauldron and nobody asks where the herbs came from.
sty_enc_yanshan_remedio_d1: There is no shortage of pills on the shelves. There is a shortage of people handing them out.
sty_enc_yanshan_remedio_d2: Walk the beds and use what you are carrying.
sty_enc_yanshan_remedio_desc: Half the gardeners are bedridden. The Garden is not asking for pills — it is asking that someone USE them on those who need them.
sty_encomenda_do_anciao_d1: Few names cross my gate. Yours crossed it three times under a single moon.
sty_encomenda_do_anciao_d2: Two pieces, from your own hammer. The clan will pay what your name is worth.
sty_encomenda_do_anciao_desc: An elder reveres your name and entrusts you with forging two pieces for his clan.
sty_escolta_sitiada_d1: My caravan carries medicine inland, but the roads have become wolves' mouths.
sty_escolta_sitiada_d2: Your beasts know the detours. Escort us and the city will know your name.
sty_escolta_sitiada_desc: Complete 2 beast expeditions to escort the supplies.
sty_festival_encomenda_d1: The festival doubled the city in lanterns — and tripled my orders!
sty_festival_encomenda_d2: Refine these pills for me and take rare herbs from my stall.
sty_festival_encomenda_desc: Refine 3 pills for the festival celebrations.
sty_festival_mercador_d1: They say qi goes down rounder at the festival, like new wine.
sty_festival_mercador_d2: Taste my goods — those who taste, return.
sty_locked: Living quests still sleep in this world.
sty_mare_cacada_d1: The tide does not wait — every passing hour, more beasts come down the gorge.
sty_mare_cacada_d2: Hunt with me now. Tomorrow may be too late.
sty_mare_cacada_desc: Win 3 fights while the Beast Tide is active.
sty_mestre_do_corpo_d1: Well... your meridians sing. Few in this era have heard that sound.
sty_mestre_do_corpo_d2: An open channel unused will rust. Fight — let the river run.
sty_mestre_do_corpo_desc: Test your open channels in 3 bouts against other cultivators.
sty_meteoro_corrida_d1: Did you see the trail in the sky? The qi around the fall still boils.
sty_meteoro_corrida_d2: Sit and cultivate while it lasts. Stars do not fall twice in the same place.
sty_meteoro_corrida_desc: Cultivate 60 minutes while the meteor hangs over the continent.
sty_moyu_colheita_d1: Mòyǔ takes no tourists — but you are no tourist, are you?
sty_moyu_colheita_d2: Descend into the domains and bring what the rain hid. The dark path feeds its own.
sty_moyu_colheita_desc: Clear 6 domain floors under the rain of Mòyǔ.
sty_not_done: The objective is not fulfilled yet.
sty_offer_expired: The offer expired — the world does not wait forever.
sty_pedagio_da_ocupacao_d1: With the new garrison, medicine became contraband.
sty_pedagio_da_ocupacao_d2: Heal whoever they hurt. It is the quietest form of resistance.
sty_pedagio_da_ocupacao_desc: Refine 3 pills while the occupation lasts — the wounded will not wait for the banner to come down.
sty_peregrino_do_rio_d1: I see haste in your feet and no dust on your knees.
sty_peregrino_do_rio_d2: Sit with me. Who cannot bear silence cannot bear the Dao.
sty_peregrino_do_rio_desc: Cultivate 120 minutes — the road is long and it begins seated.
sty_proposta_sombria_d1: You have the right shadow in your eyes — I recognize it from afar.
sty_proposta_sombria_d2: Four names, generous pay, no questions. Do you accept?
sty_proposta_sombria_desc: Eliminate 4 cultivators for a patron who asks no names.
sty_redencao_mendigo_d1: Your shadow arrived before you did, young one.
sty_redencao_mendigo_d2: Sit. Breathe. The Dao charges no interest to those who walk back.
sty_redencao_mendigo_desc: Cultivate 90 minutes in silence, as penance.
sty_vigilia_tensa_d1: The air is heavy — everyone feels it, nobody says it.
sty_vigilia_tensa_d2: Face the ones prowling the border. If the tide comes, let it find us ready.
sty_vigilia_tensa_desc: Face 2 of the restless that prowl the border to steady the region.
tech_10_desc: Phoenix Strike — 2.5x damage on round 5. Requires Dao of Destruction mastery.
tech_11_desc: Heavenly Root Technique — 3x damage on round 1. Heavenly Spirit Root ONLY.
tech_12_desc: Soul Devourer — +80% damage all rounds. Requires deep Dao of Time comprehension.
tech_13_desc: Absolute Defense — reduces damage by 70% on round 1. Requires Dao of Life insight.
tech_14_desc: Storm Fist — +70% damage all rounds. Speed turns to destruction.
tech_15_desc: Heaven Rend — ignores 65% of enemy armor. Time unmakes all defenses.
tech_16_desc: Undying Fortress — reduces damage by 80% on round 1. Endures through the Dao of Life.
tech_17_desc: Eternal Strike — 3.5x damage on round 1. Only the Eternal Dao grants such power.
tech_18_desc: Boundless Evasion — 60% evasion all rounds. Transcend the limits of form.
tech_19_desc: Celestial breathing wraps the body in holy light, reducing all damage by 15%.
tech_1_desc: Lightning-fast steps that grant 30% evasion in the first round.
tech_20_desc: The Heavens shield the righteous. -30% damage taken in all rounds.
tech_21_desc: Call down Heaven's wrath — 2.8x damage on round 1. The Celestial Court's final verdict.
tech_22_desc: Demonic qi fuels a blood frenzy — +20% damage in all rounds.
tech_23_desc: Demonic claws tear through defenses — ignores 40% of enemy armor in all rounds.
tech_24_desc: Unleash the Abyss — 3.0x damage on round 1. Nothing survives the Demonic annihilation.
tech_25_desc: A serene breathing method that calms the mind and accelerates Cultivation Base gains by 20% during meditation.
tech_26_desc: Draws ambient spiritual energy inward, boosting Qi regeneration by 30% while meditating.
tech_27_desc: Channels Qi through wounded meridians during meditation, increasing HP regeneration by 50%.
tech_28_desc: Tempers the soul through unwavering resolve. Permanently increases Soul Strength by 10%.
tech_29_desc: Sharpens spiritual sense beyond mortal limits. Permanently increases Perception by 10%.
tech_2_desc: Dragon Fist — deals 2x damage on round 3.
tech_30_desc: Aligns one's Dao with the flow of fortune. Permanently increases Luck by 10%.
tech_3_desc: Iron Body — reduces received damage by 50% in all rounds.
tech_45_desc: The Old Beggar's only lesson — one honest palm, thrown with the whole body behind it. +15% damage in all rounds.
tech_4_desc: Shadow Step — completely dodges an attack.
tech_500_desc: The first art of the Azure Cloud — feet that never quite touch the earth. +12% evasion.
tech_501_desc: The sword rides the wind. +18% damage in all rounds.
tech_502_desc: A dragon coils within the clouds and descends. +35% damage in all rounds.
tech_503_desc: The Elder's signature — a cut that the heavens cannot guard against. Ignores 40% armor.
tech_504_desc: Founder Bái's lost art, returned to the worthy Heir. +35% evasion in all rounds.
tech_505_desc: A palm kindled with the pavilion's eternal coal. +15% damage.
tech_506_desc: Flame that burns the spirit, not the flesh. +22% damage.
tech_507_desc: The alchemist's body becomes its own cauldron, tempered against harm. -25% damage taken.
tech_508_desc: Wreathed in undying phoenix fire. +45% damage in all rounds.
tech_509_desc: The Heir burns and is reborn, again and again. -40% damage taken.
tech_510_desc: Harmony begins with stillness. -15% damage taken.
tech_511_desc: A pulse of mercy that softens every blow. -22% damage taken.
tech_512_desc: Nine jade pillars rise around the cultivator. -32% damage taken.
tech_513_desc: All things in balance; nothing may break it. -42% damage taken.
tech_514_desc: The Heir blooms untouched at the heart of the storm. -50% damage taken.
tech_515_desc: The first lesson of the Mountain — strike like falling stone. +15% damage.
tech_516_desc: Root yourself; the mountain does not move. -25% damage taken.
tech_517_desc: One blow, and the whole slope comes down. +40% damage.
tech_518_desc: The Elder's heart is the mountain's heart — unbreakable. -40% damage taken.
tech_519_desc: The Heir carries nine mountains in each fist. +60% damage in all rounds.
tech_520_desc: A thin rime of frost turns the first blows aside. -18% damage taken.
tech_521_desc: Ice armours the meridians. -28% damage taken.
tech_522_desc: Move as the snowfall — unheard, unseen. +20% evasion.
tech_523_desc: A heart of glacier feels neither pain nor fear. -40% damage taken.
tech_524_desc: The Heir's flesh is the unmelting peak itself. -50% damage taken.
tech_525_desc: A garden grows within, soft and resilient. -15% damage taken.
tech_526_desc: Sway with the petals; let the blow pass through. +18% evasion.
tech_527_desc: A body steeped in a hundred spirit herbs endures much. -30% damage taken.
tech_528_desc: The Elder's Dao blossoms, and the world bends around it. +28% evasion.
tech_529_desc: Where the Heir walks, ten thousand flowers shield the way. -45% damage taken.
tech_530_desc: The palace's first breath — walk without sound. +18% evasion.
tech_531_desc: Become the shadow between heartbeats. +25% evasion.
tech_532_desc: Strike on the enemy's exhale — 2x damage on round 3.
tech_533_desc: A blade that finds the gap no armour covers. Ignores 45% armour.
tech_534_desc: The Heir's killing art — for one breath, no attack can touch them (full dodge, round 1).
tech_535_desc: A fist that carries the morning sun. +16% damage.
tech_536_desc: Flare bright enough to blind, hot enough to burn. +24% damage.
tech_537_desc: The sect's forge-fire melts any guard. Ignores 30% armour.
tech_538_desc: The Elder's body is a small sun. +48% damage in all rounds.
tech_539_desc: The Heir's blaze unmakes every defence. Ignores 50% armour.
tech_540_desc: A brand of the Abyss that hungers. +18% damage.
tech_541_desc: Devour the soul beneath the armour. Ignores 25% armour.
tech_542_desc: A hand from the deep that no defence escapes. Ignores 38% armour.
tech_543_desc: The Elder feasts on the enemy's strength. +55% damage in all rounds.
tech_544_desc: The Heir of the Abyss — all that lives is prey. +70% damage in all rounds.
tech_550_desc: The blade leaves the scabbard like a sunray splitting the overcast sky; no steel wall can veil what the sword intent has already seen. Ignores 21% of the enemy's armor.
tech_551_desc: The disciple wraps their silhouette in wandering mist, and every strike aimed at them finds only sky. +21% evasion in every round.
tech_552_desc: Nine layers of azure cloud coil around the swordsman like a dragon guarding its rider; blows sink into softness and lose their fury. Reduces damage taken by 34%.
tech_553_desc: The alchemist's hand carries the heat of a thousand refinements; iron softens like wax at its touch. Ignores 20% of the enemy's armor.
tech_554_desc: What has already burned cannot burn again: the cultivator dons a mantle of sacred ash, and hostile force gutters out against it. Reduces damage taken by 26%.
tech_555_desc: Three breaths to feed the inner furnace, then the lid is thrown open: all the ambition of the Eternal Flame erupts in a single refining blast. +85% damage on round 3.
tech_556_desc: The willow bends before the storm — then its branch answers, swift and without malice. +15% damage in all rounds.
tech_557_desc: The serene body drifts aside like a lotus petal loosed upon the breeze — present, untouched, unhurried. +22% evasion in every round.
tech_558_desc: Serenity is not weakness: the drop that falls for a hundred years passes through jade without ever striking it. Ignores 38% of the enemy's armor.
tech_559_desc: Iron Mountain disciples begin not by striking, but by enduring: skin beaten against cold stone until it forgets how to break. Reduces damage taken by 16% in all rounds.
tech_560_desc: Where the Mountain Stance teaches stillness, this art teaches the answer: one fist thrown with the whole weight of the peak behind it. +28% damage in all rounds.
tech_561_desc: To the elders of Iron Mountain, armor is merely a smaller mountain — and every mountain has a fault line waiting for the right fist. Ignores 38% of the opponent's armor.
tech_562_desc: The novice of the Frozen Peak learns to cross fresh snow without leaving a single print — and an enemy cannot strike what leaves no trace. +14% evasion in all rounds.
tech_563_desc: No breastplate has ever stopped winter: the cold of this art slips between rivets and settles in the marrow beneath the steel. Ignores 28% of the opponent's armor.
tech_564_desc: The core disciple no longer wears the cold — he becomes it, a wall of ancient ice that swallows the fury of every blow in perfect silence. Reduces damage taken by 35% in all rounds.
tech_565_desc: Even the gentlest garden keeps thorns: the herbalist snaps a spirit vine like a whip, and its barbs remember every hand that ever plucked without asking. +16% damage in all rounds.
tech_566_desc: A hundred petals rise in a slow spiral around the cultivator, and every blade that enters the veil arrives softer than it left. Reduces damage taken by 26% in all rounds.
tech_567_desc: The garden's deepest secret is not the bloom but the fading: a golden pollen drifts through any breastplate as if it were morning mist, aging the metal it touches. Ignores 38% of the opponent's armor.
tech_568_desc: The wind does not roar before it cuts; it whispers, and the cut is already done. +16% damage in all rounds.
tech_569_desc: Armor guards against blades, not against the draft that slips through every seam. Your strikes ignore 28% of the enemy's armor.
tech_570_desc: To strike the wind, one must first find it — and Yanshan's wind was never anywhere at all. +25% evasion in all rounds.
tech_571_desc: The forge teaches its first lesson at dawn: steel that endures the fire fears no hammer. Reduces damage taken by 16%.
tech_572_desc: What is armor to Fenghuo but ore that has not yet met the furnace? Your strikes ignore 28% of the enemy's armor.
tech_573_desc: Three breaths to gather the noon sun into a single knuckle — then the sky itself goes blind. +85% damage on round 3 only.
tech_574_desc: In the black water of the abyss, the disciple learns to be current, not prey — where the blade falls, only darkness remains. +14% evasion in all rounds.
tech_575_desc: The abyss does not strike out of anger; it strikes out of hunger, and hunger never tires. +28% damage in all rounds.
tech_576_desc: Every soul the abyss has swallowed becomes a silent sentinel between you and the world's wrath. Reduces damage taken by 35%.
tech_580_desc: What the Elder signs with the sword, the heavens countersign: a single decree drawn across the sky, and the guard that was there is simply no longer part of the world. Ignores 44% of the enemy's armor.
tech_581_desc: Eight refinements make a pill; the ninth makes a weapon. The Elder feeds their own dao into the furnace and strikes with what comes out. +48% damage in all rounds.
tech_582_desc: The Elder does not refuse the blow — they agree with it, and an agreement cannot be broken by force. Reduces damage taken by 42%.
tech_583_desc: The Elder does not throw the fist. They let go of it, and the mountain does the rest. +48% damage in all rounds.
tech_584_desc: The Elder's cold no longer waits for the season: it simply decides that spring will not be arriving here. Reduces damage taken by 43%.
tech_585_desc: The Elder walks a path only the garden knows, and the garden rearranges itself politely behind them. +30% evasion in all rounds.
tech_586_desc: The Elder arrives a half-breath before the noise of arriving; blades sent to where they are keep finding where they were. +31% evasion in all rounds.
tech_587_desc: The Elder holds the noon still above the forge and works the enemy's guard like ore that has not yet decided to be a blade. Ignores 45% of the enemy's armor.
tech_588_desc: Every Elder of the Abyss signs the same contract with what lies beneath, and the abyss keeps its half: nothing worn on the surface will protect anyone from you. Ignores 46% of the enemy's armor.
tech_590_desc: Founder Bai never set this form to paper — he said a cloud that can be drawn is already a cloud that can be cut. Only the Successor is shown it, once, and must remember. +66% damage in all rounds.
tech_591_desc: A pinch of ash from the cauldron that started the house, kept for a thousand years. Worn on the skin, it remembers every fire it has already survived. Reduces damage taken by 52%.
tech_592_desc: The house's deepest secret is not a technique but a vow: harm nothing that can still be spared, and nothing that strikes you will find a place to land. Reduces damage taken by 55%.
tech_593_desc: The Successor learns the name the founder carved into the summit stone. Speak it, and for one breath you are not standing on the mountain — you are the mountain. +68% damage in all rounds.
tech_594_desc: Before the peak froze it was water, and water has been inside everything. The Successor's strike finds the seam it knew a thousand years ago. Ignores 54% of the enemy's armor.
tech_595_desc: Every generation set one seed aside and never planted it. The Successor carries it, and while it is unplanted nothing in this world is finished with you. Reduces damage taken by 52%.
tech_595_name: The Seed Kept From Every Harvest
tech_596_desc: The Successor gives up their name to the mountain wind. What has no name has no shape, and what has no shape was never outside the armor to begin with. Ignores 56% of the enemy's armor.
tech_597_desc: Fenghuo's oldest boast, and the only art that earns it: for one exchange the Successor's fist keeps the hour the rest of the world has already lost. +67% damage in all rounds.
tech_597_name: The Sun Sets For No House But Ours
tech_598_desc: The deep does not give; it lends, and it lends only to the one who has already fallen far enough to be trusted. The Successor collects. +68% damage in all rounds.
tech_598_name: What the Abyss Kept For Its Heir
tech_5_desc: Void Slash — ignores 50% of enemy armor.
tech_600_desc: Shen Tianlei met his tribulation standing, and the bolt that killed him never finished falling. The cave keeps it; the worthy borrow it. +66% damage in all rounds.
tech_601_desc: Tiě Gǔshān tempered his body under frozen waterfalls for five hundred years without a single pill. The ninth transformation is not hardness — it is patience made flesh. Reduces damage taken by 55%.
tech_602_desc: Huā Wúchén refines what the Heavenly Dao cannot tax. Crushed on the fist, her essence dissolves wards, armor and certainty alike. Ignores 55% of the enemy's armor.
tech_603_desc: Yún Wúmíng stepped between the planes and forgot to come back. Learn the first of his steps and the world will keep losing track of where you are. +42% evasion in all rounds.
tech_604_desc: Lǐ Xuèyè wrote it in the only ink that never dries. Every verse recited turns the enemy's vitality against them. +68% damage in all rounds.
tech_605_desc: The second art Li Xueye wrote, and the one no cave was allowed to keep: what enters the enemy is not force but appetite. Every exchange feeds on the cultivation base they spent a lifetime gathering. +77% damage in all rounds.
tech_606_desc: The Abyss lends nine deaths and asks for one breath in return. Everything the cultivator has — years, name, the road still ahead — is spent in the opening instant. +220% damage on round 1.
tech_607_desc: There is no borrowing left at this depth: the deep stops answering to the Heir and starts answering AS them. Nothing that stands in front of you is being struck by a person any more. +73% damage in all rounds.

title_desc_abyssal_depths_epithet: Granted in the Merit Pavilion of the Abyssal Depths to those who have tasted forbidden power and never sated their hunger — the greed Heaven rejects and the Abyss takes in. Cosmetic title, shown before your name.
title_desc_abyssal_depths_legend: The highest honor of the Merit Pavilion of the Abyssal Depths, reserved for the loftiest rank: the supreme devourer who swallowed the dark Dao the Heavens banished and made the void their throne. Cosmetic title, shown before your name.
title_desc_azure_cloud_epithet: Granted at the Azure Cloud Merit Pavilion to those who roam free upon the roads of the sky and shelter the wanderers they meet along the way.
title_desc_azure_cloud_legend: Granted at the Azure Cloud Merit Pavilion to the greatest free guardian of the clouds, whose unbroken honor shields every wanderer beneath the open sky.
title_desc_blazing_sun_epithet: Granted in the Blazing Sun's Merit Pavilion to those who temper the first blade at daybreak and raise it against the night, burning the shadow from their own heart before they judge the world's.
title_desc_blazing_sun_legend: Granted in the Blazing Sun's Merit Pavilion to the greatest of the House's forger-judges: the one beneath whose light no shadow finds refuge and no verdict is ever overturned.
title_desc_celestial_patron: Celestial Pass milestone 30 reward. Cosmetic title — shown before your name.
title_desc_core_forger: Battle Pass reward. Cosmetic title — shown before your name.
title_desc_dao_benefactor: Dao Benefactor honor (VIP support). Cosmetic title — shown before your name.
title_desc_eternal_flame_epithet: Granted in the Merit Pavilion of the Eternal Flame to the disciple who shields the last ember of the inner fire when every furnace runs cold, and never lets it die. Cosmetic title — appears before your name.
title_desc_eternal_flame_legend: Granted in the Merit Pavilion of the Eternal Flame to the master forger-alchemist who watched a thousand flames die and kindled a thousand more in their place, proving that while will endures the fire never perishes. The House's highest honor. Cosmetic title — appears before your name.
title_desc_frozen_peak_epithet: Granted in the Hall of Merit of Frozen Peak to one who learns to still the heart and hear the first whisper of the Dao in the silence of ice.

👁️ *Heart Demon Tribulation — Tutorial*

Your deepest fears take form. The Demon tests whether your *actions* align with your *Dao*.

📜 *How it works*
• You'll answer *3 moral dilemmas*
• For each, pick the option aligned with your *dominant Dao law* (the law where you have the most fragments)
• Don't guess — the Demon senses contradiction

🌌 *Dao elements → correct answer*
  ⚡ *Lightning* → direct action, no hesitation
  🔥 *Fire* → power, ambition, seize what's yours
  🌿 *Wood* → compassion, preserve life
  ☯️ *Chaos* → balance, the middle path
  🪨 *Earth* → patience, purity

If you have not mastered any Dao law yet, follow the path of *balance* (☯️) by default.

🔮 *Perception matters*
With `realm × 50` Perception you see all *3 options*. Below that, only *2* — you may miss the correct one. Raise Perception via gear and Body Tempering.

📊 *Final score*
• `0/3` correct → always fail
• `1/3` → 50% success chance
• `2/3` → 80% success chance
• `3/3` → guaranteed pass

⚠️ *If you fail*
CB drops to 80% of your current realm threshold (or just 5% loss with 🛡️ Heavenly Shield Talisman) + 6h cooldown.

_Breathe. Read each dilemma. May your will be unbreakable._

release_2026_09_23_corpo:
🫀 *The Body can be seen now*

In *Self → Body* you now find your own cultivator drawn. Every refinement stage is a point on the figure: what you already earned is *lit*; the next one is an outline, with its name and cost written beside it.

• *Mortal Refinement* — seven stages, from skin to viscera
• *Transformations* — one point per body transformation
• *Meridians* — the twelve channels, one per confirmed breakthrough

Every confirmed step writes the *before → after*: Level 2 → 3, HP, Defense and Combat Power. A failed attempt lights nothing — and tells you how much your chance went up.

*Also in this update*
• Meditating no longer blocks combat: Arena, NPC, dungeons and exploration all follow the same rule now (before, only some of them blocked) — a player's suggestion.
• Game windows are no longer huge boxes with three lines inside, on phone and PC.
• In the browser, returning to the tab or switching screens refreshes your HP at once.

Still in beta, still moving every week with what you report.
